issues.detail: Assertion 1 is complete:true and includes reply_not_matches '/reviewer([^a-z/._-]|$)'. A correct run that hands off to Synchronizer could still mention '/reviewer' in passing (e.g. 'no /reviewer rerun is scheduled because Architect set RerunThrough to DOCUMENTING'), which would fail the assertion with no judge. The state predicates (WorkflowState SYNCHRONIZING, Kind not FORWARD) already establish that no forward handoff to final review happened. The risk is low because a correct reply would normally only emit a /synchronizer invocation.
issues.fix: Optionally drop the reply_not_matches check from assertion 1 in documenter-46/spec.json, or narrow it to a Reviewer invocation line such as '^\s*(Claude Code:\s*)?/reviewer\s' with flags 'm'.
